findings.title: Plugin request logs no longer include the trace ID
findings.body: The previous `logRequest` added `traceID` to the completion log when one was available. This log parameter list omits it, and the new contextual logger middleware does not add a trace ID to the context attributes. As a result, plugin request completion logs lose their direct trace correlation, making it harder to investigate requests that also emit tracing data.

findings.title: FromContext discards logs recorded by the test logger
findings.body: `FromContext` returns a fresh `TestLogger` with independent log fields. `LoggerMiddleware` now logs through the logger returned by `FromContext`, so tests that inspect the original `TestLogger` will see no calls or messages. Return the same fake or share its recorded log state so middleware logging remains observable in tests.
